name: Fullerton Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Fullerton Technology Co., Ltd. provides activity management services; and operates an online booking service platform in Taiwan. It also operates an Ez Booking, a cross-cinema ticket booking platform that offers movie booking and online e-ticketing services; and Niceday Play Experience, a reservation platform for a few hours of activity experience, or a small day trip. In addition, the company provides a digital imaging service platform; and prepaid card communication services, as well as operates telecom communications exchange platform. Further, it engages in combining software and hardware applications to create a convenient and smart life. Fullerton Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 1992 and is based in New Taipei City, Taiwan.
